mapper.select: SELECT user_source AS userSource, create_time AS createTime FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(content)) FROM note_notes WHERE del_flag = '0' AND user_id = #{userId}), 0) AS SIGNED) AS noteBytes, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(size) FROM basics_file WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_by = #{userId}), 0) AS SIGNED) AS fileBytes
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(content)), 0) AS SIGNED) FROM note_notes WHERE trash_id = #{trashId} AND del_flag <> '0'

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.user_source AS userSource, COALESCE(n.note_bytes, 0) AS noteBytes, COALESCE(f.file_bytes, 0) AS fileBytes, COALESCE(n.note_bytes, 0) + COALESCE(f.file_bytes, 0) AS usedBytes FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(content)) AS note_bytes FROM note_notes WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY user_id) n ON n.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT create_by AS user_id, SUM(size) AS file_bytes FROM basics_file WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY create_by) f ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_type = 'cli_user'
AND (u.user_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.user_source = #{userSource}
ORDER BY usedBytes DESC, u.user_id ASC
